entries.name: segregated-tuple-AND-ph-dKn-v0-a2#0
entries.description: [AND|ph|dKn|v0] sigma-rust's whole tree (tree v0) guards a plain box (no token, no register; the input's extension empty), SPENT at activated 2 under nine headers; the jars' fullReduction: throws RuntimeException. The box does NOT spend. SEGREGATED: the tuple of three is the tree's constant; `ConstantPlaceholder.eval` checks the constant against its type, and a tuple of other than two items is no value of its type there, so the reduction throws (`Unsupported tuple type`). A port that reads the placeholder without the check, or reduces the tree again with its constants substituted, answers here.
